---
title: "Yet Another map"
engine: knitr
filters:
  - shinylive
---


```{shinylive-r}
#| standalone: true
#| viewerHeight: 560

library(shiny)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Pre-built spatial snapshot committed in data/ (län polygons with 2025 median
# price + SCB fritidsfiske days, plus water/neighbour geometries). The browser
# can't run pxweb/swemaps2/rnaturalearth, so the pipeline in
# yet_another_map__plot.R runs locally instead — regenerate with:
#   my_year <- 2025; source("yet_another_map__plot.R")
#   saveRDS(list(df = df, water = water, neighbours = neighbours),
#           "data/yet_another_map.rds")
url <- "https://raukr-housing-2026.github.io/Housing-2026/data/yet_another_map.rds"
download.file(url, "yet_another_map.rds")
d <- readRDS("yet_another_map.rds")
df <- d$df
water <- d$water
neighbours <- d$neighbours

map <- ggplot() +
   geom_sf(data = df, aes(geometry = geometry, fill = median_price)) +
   geom_sf(data = neighbours, fill = "grey") +
   geom_sf(data = water, fill = "blue3") +
   theme_void() +
   scale_fill_distiller(
      palette = "Reds",
      direction = 1,
      name = "median housing price")

# median price / fishing days, with no-fishing län set to 1 day
norm_df <- df |>
   mutate(
      fishing_days = coalesce(`Antal dagar i tusental, totalt`, 1),
      fishing_days = if_else(fishing_days == 0, 1, fishing_days),
      norm = median_price / fishing_days)

ui <- plotOutput("map", click = "map_click")

server <- function(input, output) {

   fish_sf <-
   st_sample(
      st_buffer(water, -25000), # Button only fully in water
      size = 1) |>
      st_buffer(dist = 25000) # Button size

   map <- map +
            geom_sf_text(data = fish_sf, label = "🐟", size = 5) +
            ## Emoji does not respect alpha, so cover:
            geom_sf(data = fish_sf, fill = 'blue3', alpha = 1/2, colour = 'blue3')

   hit <- reactiveVal(FALSE)
   observeEvent(input$map_click, {
      req(input$map_click)
      click_pt <-
      st_point(c(input$map_click$x, input$map_click$y)) |>
      st_sfc(crs = st_crs(fish_sf))

      if ( any( st_intersects(click_pt, fish_sf, sparse = FALSE ) ) ) { hit(TRUE) } } )

   output$map <-
      renderPlot(
         if( !hit() ) { map
         } else       { map +
           ggtitle('Fishing mode activated') +
           geom_sf(data = norm_df, aes(geometry = geometry, fill = norm)) +
           scale_fill_distiller(
              palette = 'Reds',
              direction = 1,
              limits = c(0, max(norm_df$norm, na.rm = TRUE)),
              name = 'median housing price\n normalized by fishing days')
         } ) }

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```
